title.en: Take scanner, multimeter and data core
title.ar: Take scanner, multimeter and data core

continuity_modifiers.label: Preparation quality → starting power
continuity_modifiers.reason: Every station visited: full power reserve granted.

topic.en: EVA preparation is a checklist, not a formality
topic.ar: EVA preparation is a checklist, not a formality

detail.en: NASA astronauts pre-breathe and verify suit, consumables and tools before every EVA; missing consumables shorten the usable EVA time.
detail.ar: NASA astronauts pre-breathe and verify suit, consumables and tools before every EVA; missing consumables shorten the usable EVA time.

reports.disclaimer: Educational game simulation. Resource numbers are simplified for gameplay, not real mission planning data.

summary.en: Preparation complete. Loadout quality now feeds the Mission Continuity System.
summary.ar: Preparation complete. Loadout quality now feeds the Mission Continuity System.

continuity_modifiers.label: Survey discipline → power reserve
continuity_modifiers.reason: Clean survey: habitat bus left balanced.

detail.en: NASA uses analog missions (NEEMO, HERA, Desert RATS) to rehearse isolation, procedures and hardware failures before flight.
detail.ar: NASA uses analog missions (NEEMO, HERA, Desert RATS) to rehearse isolation, procedures and hardware failures before flight.

reports.disclaimer: Educational game simulation. Readings are invented for gameplay.

summary.en: Survey complete: a live water leak, a power module to connect and a suspect device.
summary.ar: Survey complete: a live water leak, a power module to connect and a suspect device.

topic.en: Calibration is part of the measurement
topic.ar: Calibration is part of the measurement

detail.en: Spaceflight instruments are re-calibrated against known references in flight; without it, a repaired sensor still produces unusable science.
detail.ar: Spaceflight instruments are re-calibrated against known references in flight; without it, a repaired sensor still produces unusable science.

reports.disclaimer: Educational game simulation. Temperatures and voltages are invented.

summary.en: Device repaired and calibrated. Tool condition carries forward.
summary.ar: Device repaired and calibrated. Tool condition carries forward.

continuity_modifiers.label: Drill discipline → oxygen reserve
continuity_modifiers.reason: No safety mistakes: extra oxygen margin.

detail.en: ISS fire response: warn the crew, isolate power to the affected rack, don protection, then suppress and clean the atmosphere.
detail.ar: ISS fire response: warn the crew, isolate power to the affected rack, don protection, then suppress and clean the atmosphere.

reports.disclaimer: Educational game simulation. Not a real fire-response procedure.

summary.en: Earth Analog training complete. Your readiness index now decides how Mars treats you.
summary.ar: Earth Analog training complete. Your readiness index now decides how Mars treats you.

title.en: Collect the power module and panel
title.ar: Collect the power module and panel

detail.en: Electrical work in spaceflight hardware follows lock-out/tag-out: energy sources are isolated and labelled before maintenance.
detail.ar: Electrical work in spaceflight hardware follows lock-out/tag-out: energy sources are isolated and labelled before maintenance.

reports.disclaimer: Educational game simulation. Voltages and energy units are simplified.

summary.en: Habitat bus is online with solar support.
summary.ar: Habitat bus is online with solar support.

continuity_modifiers.label: Comms recovery → power reserve
continuity_modifiers.reason: Fast, clean recovery left the radio budget intact.

detail.en: NASA's Deep Space Network uses large steerable dishes; pointing accuracy and link margin decide whether a spacecraft can be heard at all.
detail.ar: NASA's Deep Space Network uses large steerable dishes; pointing accuracy and link margin decide whether a spacecraft can be heard at all.

reports.disclaimer: Educational game simulation. Link budgets are simplified.

title.en: Locate the leak with the scanner
title.ar: Locate the leak with the scanner

continuity_modifiers.label: Leak handling → water reserve
continuity_modifiers.reason: Correct order, no spillage: water reserve bonus.

detail.en: On the ISS, fluid lines are isolated with quick-disconnects and valves before any maintenance so a repair cannot drain the loop.
detail.ar: On the ISS, fluid lines are isolated with quick-disconnects and valves before any maintenance so a repair cannot drain the loop.

science_notes.source: NASA – ISS Environmental Control and Life Support System (ECLSS)

reports.disclaimer: Educational game simulation. Pressure and water values are simplified.

summary.en: Leak isolated and repaired. Water discipline now carries into the next stages.
summary.ar: Leak isolated and repaired. Water discipline now carries into the next stages.

detail.en: The ISS Water Recovery System distills urine and processes cabin condensate; NASA has demonstrated recovering about 98% of water aboard the station.
detail.ar: The ISS Water Recovery System distills urine and processes cabin condensate; NASA has demonstrated recovering about 98% of water aboard the station.

science_notes.source: NASA – Water Recovery System / ECLSS announcement (2023)

reports.disclaimer: Educational game simulation. Recovery rates are simplified.

summary.en: Closed water loop running. Efficiency carries to Mars.
summary.ar: Closed water loop running. Efficiency carries to Mars.

continuity_modifiers.label: EVA discipline → oxygen reserve
continuity_modifiers.reason: Efficient EVA left a healthy oxygen margin.

detail.en: Curiosity's Radiation Assessment Detector measured about 0.67 millisieverts per day on the surface – far above Earth's background, which drives habitat shielding design.
detail.ar: Curiosity's Radiation Assessment Detector measured about 0.67 millisieverts per day on the surface – far above Earth's background, which drives habitat shielding design.

science_notes.source: NASA/JPL – Curiosity RAD results (Hassler et al., Science 2014)

detail.en: Real sites are chosen for engineering safety (slope, rocks, elevation) and science value; Jezero Crater was selected for its ancient river delta.
detail.ar: Real sites are chosen for engineering safety (slope, rocks, elevation) and science value; Jezero Crater was selected for its ancient river delta.

reports.disclaimer: Educational game simulation. Distances, resources and radiation values are simplified.

summary.en: Base established. Long-range traverses and crew care are now available.
summary.ar: Base established. Long-range traverses and crew care are now available.

topic.en: Rover driving is slow and careful
topic.ar: Rover driving is slow and careful

detail.en: Perseverance drives tens to a few hundred metres per sol; terrain relative navigation and hazard avoidance matter more than speed.
detail.ar: Perseverance drives tens to a few hundred metres per sol; terrain relative navigation and hazard avoidance matter more than speed.

reports.disclaimer: Educational game simulation. Rover dynamics are game-scaled, not a mobility model.

summary.en: Far sites reached. Geological sampling is now possible.
summary.ar: Far sites reached. Geological sampling is now possible.

detail.en: Microgravity shifts body fluids headward, reduces plasma volume and deconditions the cardiovascular system; hydration and exercise are standard countermeasures.
detail.ar: Microgravity shifts body fluids headward, reduces plasma volume and deconditions the cardiovascular system; hydration and exercise are standard countermeasures.

reports.disclaimer: Educational game simulation with invented vital signs. This is NOT medical guidance and must never be used for real health decisions.

summary.en: Crew stabilised inside the simulation. Emergency response training unlocked.
summary.ar: Crew stabilised inside the simulation. Emergency response training unlocked.

continuity_modifiers.label: Atmosphere management → oxygen reserve
continuity_modifiers.reason: Careful CO2 use kept the cabin breathable.

detail.en: In microgravity, hot gas does not rise, so flames become spherical, burn cooler and can persist at lower oxygen levels; NASA's FLEX experiments even observed 'cool flames' continuing after the visible flame went out.
detail.ar: In microgravity, hot gas does not rise, so flames become spherical, burn cooler and can persist at lower oxygen levels; NASA's FLEX experiments even observed 'cool flames' continuing after the visible flame went out.

detail.en: The ISS uses CO2 extinguishers because water or powder would float freely and damage equipment; CO2 displaces oxygen locally, which is itself a crew hazard.
detail.ar: The ISS uses CO2 extinguishers because water or powder would float freely and damage equipment; CO2 displaces oxygen locally, which is itself a crew hazard.

science_notes.source: NASA – ISS fire safety hardware (curated summary)

reports.disclaimer: Educational game simulation. Fire and atmosphere physics are simplified for gameplay.

summary.en: Fire suppressed and the cabin certified safe.
summary.ar: Fire suppressed and the cabin certified safe.

title.en: Drill and seal a core sample
title.ar: Drill and seal a core sample

title.en: Log the finding in the science database
title.ar: Log the finding in the science database

detail.en: The Martian crust is dominantly basaltic; olivine-rich and clay-bearing units record how much water altered the rock.
detail.ar: The Martian crust is dominantly basaltic; olivine-rich and clay-bearing units record how much water altered the rock.

science_notes.source: NASA Mars Exploration Program – Mars facts

detail.en: Perseverance seals rock cores in ultra-clean tubes and caches them for a future Mars Sample Return campaign.
detail.ar: Perseverance seals rock cores in ultra-clean tubes and caches them for a future Mars Sample Return campaign.

science_notes.source: NASA – Mars Sample Return / Perseverance sampling

reports.disclaimer: Educational game simulation. Compositions are generated from curated mineral ranges, not measured from a real sample.

summary.en: Sample analysed and logged. The science database is now live.
summary.ar: Sample analysed and logged. The science database is now live.

detail.en: The Moon's surface gravity is about 1.62 m/s² and it has no meaningful atmosphere, so every landing must be propulsive – Apollo's LM used a throttleable descent engine.
detail.ar: The Moon's surface gravity is about 1.62 m/s² and it has no meaningful atmosphere, so every landing must be propulsive – Apollo's LM used a throttleable descent engine.

science_notes.source: NASA – Moon facts / Apollo Lunar Module

reports.disclaimer: Educational game simulation. The lander model is simplified 2-D physics, not a flight-certified simulator.

summary.en: Lunar landing certified inside the simulator.
summary.ar: Lunar landing certified inside the simulator.

detail.en: MODIS NDVI (MOD13Q1) tracks vegetation greenness, MODIS land surface temperature (MOD11) tracks heat, and GPM IMERG tracks precipitation. NASA POWER serves monthly aggregates of these climate variables without an API key.
detail.ar: MODIS NDVI (MOD13Q1) tracks vegetation greenness, MODIS land surface temperature (MOD11) tracks heat, and GPM IMERG tracks precipitation. NASA POWER serves monthly aggregates of these climate variables without an API key.

reports.disclaimer: Educational analysis. Bundled grids are clearly labelled 'simulated'; live NASA POWER data is labelled 'live'.

summary.en: NOVA campaign complete: Explore. Experience. Execute.
summary.ar: NOVA campaign complete: Explore. Experience. Execute.
